scope: Preparation only: current scientific source plus two raw public T1s into new empty output roots; no original-software stage or original-software-derived image/surface input

additional_parameters.precision: existing TF32 default and validated FP32 exceptions; no half/autocast

resource_recommendation.same_device_verification: Before launch, compare the selected device UUID with the original private snapshot receipt; the public copy omits the hardware identifier. Device index alone is insufficient.

timing_protocol.cases_execution: sequential; each separate process and absent output root; preserve failures; no stage resume
timing_protocol.outer_wall: supervisor begins before interpreter startup and ends after child exit/reaping and final artifact writes; include imports, preflight hashing, all stage IO and report publication
timing_protocol.cli_wall: Popen to CLI exit includes interpreter initialization, model loading, transfers, computation, writeout and validation
timing_protocol.stage_wall: same monotonic clock; each named stage includes its own read/write and synchronization; preserve nested boundaries and do not sum overlaps
timing_protocol.memory: one contemporaneous sample of parent and all live descendants on selected GPU; sum same-sample owned bytes, never sum individual historical peaks
timing_protocol.memory_mapping: require verified host/container PID identity map; NVML if available; record backend, query errors, missing samples, maximum interval, namespace mapping; unresolved owned peak remains null
timing_protocol.cold_warm: record first-use JIT/model cache and loading separately without excluding them from full wall
timing_protocol.precision_validation: record actual TF32 switches and intentional FP32 operations; no undocumented low-precision changes

completion_gate.mesh_quality: all generated final surfaces finite, closed/manifold, valid indices, consistent orientation, nonzero face area and zero geometric intersections; preserve existing complete GA gate
completion_gate.reference_comparison: separate post-run evaluation of geometry/images/labels/metrics against declared original-software reference; record versions, hashes and stage/whole timing. Original outputs may enter evaluator only, never candidate pipeline. No accuracy/equivalence claim before actual paired comparison
completion_gate.visualization: write T1/segmentation overlays and white/pial/registered-sphere QC images only after outputs exist

known_harness_issue.issue: Python profile call omits input_execution and overwrites parsed args; parallel request currently becomes serial
known_harness_issue.action: prepare actual serial profile; any future wrapper fix requires new script binding and review before run

forbidden: original-software executables or native-bin-dir in candidate stages
reference image/surface artifacts as candidate inputs
reduce GA iterations/population/quality checks to obtain a passing run

public_derivation.scope: Public privacy derivative only; no MRI rerun or scientific/report correction
public_derivation.redaction: Set to null; original private receipt retains the actual identifier for same-device recheck
public_derivation.preserved: Scientific source/wheel/input hashes, historical v2/v3 failures, resource observations, pending gates and whole_started=false are unchanged
